purpose: Tracks shared credential variables used by Khashi VC, Investing System, and Nous Hermes control-plane readiness. Values are never stored here.

variables.name: BINANCE_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Binance.US market data identity for crypto/perpetual technical context.

variables.name: BINANCE_SECRET_KEY
variables.purpose: Binance.US signed credential partner for market data/account-capability checks where used.

variables.name: FINNHUB_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Fundamental, macro, forex/metals provider data where covered.

variables.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Daily metals fallback and web-derived macro context.

variables.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Discord bot delivery/command token where project-owned command surfaces are enabled.

variables.name: DISCORD_TRADING_CHANNEL_ID
variables.purpose: Discord channel for trading desk notifications.

variables.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Telegram bot for mobile operator escalation.

rules: Credential health endpoints may report configured/missing/source key names only.
Credential health endpoints must never return raw values, prefixes, hashes, or lengths.
Configured credentials do not unlock live trading by themselves.
Live/paper promotion gates must consume readiness as evidence, not permission.
